subject: 🎉 New Club Alert: $club_name Now Available!
body:
Dear $first_name $last_name,

We're excited to announce a new club has been formed at our university!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
NEW CLUB ANNOUNCEMENT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Club Name: $club_name
Description: $club_description

Join today and be part of something amazing! Log into the Student Union portal to join this club and explore all the exciting activities and events planned.

Benefits of joining:
• Meet like-minded students
• Participate in exclusive events
• Access to club merchandise
• Networking opportunities
• Fun trips and activities

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Best regards,
Student Union Team
University System
